name: Wind
description: How the wind moves between buildings and through trees

about.purpose: Shows how wind moves between buildings and trees, so people find draughty corners and sheltered spots.
questions: Where is it windy or sheltered?
Does the proposal create a wind tunnel?
limits: Uses the site's buildings and trees, and buildings around the table when the table has them

controls.label: Wind speed
controls.help: The wind speed the simulation starts from, measured well above the roofs.

controls.label: Wind from
controls.help: The compass direction the wind blows from: 270 is from the west.

controls.label: Show
controls.help: Ribbons that flow with the wind, particles, or a coloured map of its speed.

controls.label: Colour range
controls.help: The speed that gets the strongest colour. Lower it to see light winds.

controls.label: Speed map underneath
controls.help: How much of the speed map shows under the ribbons or particles.

controls.label: Light the walls the wind hits
controls.help: Walls facing into the wind light up.

controls.label: Trees slow the wind
controls.help: Trees in the table's data slow the wind as it passes, and their crowns show faintly over the air.

controls.label: Detail
controls.help: Finer detail is sharper and needs more of the computer.

controls.label: Animation speed
controls.help: How fast the ribbons and particles move.

controls.label: Opacity
controls.help: How strongly the layer draws over the map.
